body.title: The Great Depression
body.creator: Various
body.description: A collection of images and documents reflecting economic collapse and everyday life during the Great Depression.
body.historicalContext: The Great Depression was a global economic downturn that had profound social and political consequences.
body.interpretation: These records show how communities adapted and how governmental responses reshaped social policy.

body.title: The First World War
body.creator: Newspapers / Private Letters
body.description: Soldier letters, trench photographs, and period newspapers showing the lived reality of war.
body.historicalContext: World War I reshaped borders and societies; its sources are essential to understanding modern history.
body.interpretation: Personal letters often reveal more about emotional landscapes than official reports.
relatedLiterature: All Quiet on the Western Front

body.title: 1918 Influenza Pandemic
body.creator: Newspapers / Health Bulletins
body.description: Contemporary reporting on the influenza outbreak and public health responses.
body.historicalContext: An acute global health crisis coinciding with the end of World War I.
body.interpretation: Reports show both medical uncertainty and the social impacts of disease.

body.title: The Harlem Renaissance
body.creator: Artists & Authors
body.description: Literary works, portraits, and exhibition materials from the Harlem Renaissance.
body.historicalContext: A flourishing of African-American art and thought centered in Harlem.
body.interpretation: The archive demonstrates a vibrant cultural dialogue that reshaped American letters.
